Fawcett earned her fifth Golden Globe Award nomination, for Best Actress in a Miniseries of Television Film.

Supporting cast member Douglas Booth has described the film's fictional universe as a cross between "The Matrix" and "Star Wars", while Kunis identified indulgence and consumerism as its underlying themes.
